event_name: Date 29 September 2019 Time 11:59 2019 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 32), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: 5th Turbocharger (TC), 5th Motor Generator Unit – Heat (MGU-H) and 4th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance to with Article 23.3 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This Penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the pit lane for a prior infringement (document 33)
